Unlock The Realm Of Opulence Indulge in unparalleled glamour and ignite your travel spirit at InterContinental Hanoi Landmark72. Ascend to a world of luxury with 359 impeccably appointed guest rooms and suites boasting breathtaking panoramic views. Embark on a culinary adventure at 5 dynamic restaurants, each showcasing exquisite cuisine, host unforgettable events in one of Hanoi’s most spacious venues, or unwind in the largest Club InterContinental Lounge in Southeast Asia. InterContinental Hanoi Landmark72 holds the distinction of being the first hotel in Hanoi to achieve Halal certification. Luxury Living Above The Clouds Indulge in a serene escape, unwinding in a deep-soaking bathtub and sleeping in ultimate comfort in one of Hanoi’s finest luxury hotel rooms. Each room and suite is graced with floor-to-ceiling windows, offering breathtaking panoramas of Hanoi cityscape. Discover Our Rooms & Suites Dining at Luxurious heights Restaurants Stellar Teppanyaki We are proud to bring a truly authentic experience at Stellar Teppanyaki where bespoke diners can enjoy the art of Teppanyaki. Our talent chef will wow fans with their knife skills and dynamic yet graceful culinary flair. Explore Now Restaurants Stellar Steakhouse Unwind at Stellar Steakhouse, Hanoi's premier destination for discerning gourmands. Savor dry-aged steaks cooked to perfection or a curated selection of exceptional cuts, while taking in breathtaking evening views of the city. Explore Now Restaurants 3 Spoons A lively all-day-dining restaurant with skyline views over Hanoi, 3 Spoons not only offers extensive breakfast - lunch - dinner buffet, but also a choice of international cuisines and interactive open stations. Explore Now Bars The Hive Lounge The Hive Lounge is where guests can experience extensive all-day light dining menu, sip on classic cocktails, or savor Hanoi's beloved Afternoon Tea – all under the warm glow of sunset and the soothing sounds of the piano. Explore Now Bars Q Bar Inspired by the beauty of O Quy Ho Pass in Northern Vietnam, Q Bar is the best sleek speakeasy bar in Hanoi. With its friendly atmosphere, dazzling views, well-made drinks and tasty light fare, Q Bar is a must visit bar for your favourite drink! Explore Now SEAMLESS CELEBRATION OF A LIFETIME World Of Weddings Celebrate love and union, with a wedding that is distinctively you. InterContinental Hanoi Landmark72’s inspiring setting offers an impressive array of magical indoor and outdoor venues for the most special day of your life.
